1.title: 1. Solar Trajectory Calculation
1.desc: Calculates the exact astronomical position of the sun (azimuth and altitude) minute by minute, based on the specified date, time, and coordinates.

2.title: 2. Terrain Data Retrieval
2.desc: We acquire tens of thousands of elevation data points within a 30km radius in all 360-degree directions from the current location (in 3-degree increments for the Web version and 1-degree increments for the Garmin version) from AWS public datasets.

3.title: 3. Terrain Profile Construction
3.desc: Calculates the 'maximum obstacle elevation angle' for each direction. This takes into account the elevation difference, the Earth's curvature, and atmospheric refraction.

4.title: 4. Shadow Detection
4.desc: Compares the sun's altitude with the terrain's obstacle angle. A minute-by-minute simulation identifies the exact moment the sun dips below (or rises above) the mountains.

5.title: 5. Result Output
5.desc: Finally, the 'true sunset' and 'true sunrise' times—when the sun actually hides behind or emerges from the physical terrain—are determined and displayed.
